rules.title: Use the wrapper
rules.text: Use the Gradle wrapper (./gradlew) so everyone builds with the same Gradle version.

rules.title: Module-scoped tasks
rules.text: Run module-scoped tasks such as ./gradlew :server:test while developing instead of the whole build.

rules.title: Filter tests
rules.text: Select tests with --tests and a class or pattern.

rules.title: Let Spotless format
rules.text: Run spotlessApply instead of fixing formatting and unused imports by hand.

rules.title: Version catalog
rules.text: Declare dependency versions in a version catalog such as libs.versions.toml.

rules.title: Trust the build cache
rules.text: Rely on the build cache and avoid clean unless something is genuinely stale.

rules.title: Declared JDK
rules.text: Use the JDK version the build declares, through JAVA_HOME or toolchains.

rules.title: Run check before a PR
rules.text: Run ./gradlew check before opening a PR.
